name: in_html
title: Frame HTML in a web page and display

origin.description: Assemble HTML and CSS into a temporary file and, by default, open it.
origin.usage: in_html(x, css = character(), pre = TRUE, display = TRUE, clean = display)

arguments.name: css
arguments.text: Character vector of CSS. An empty vector omits the style element.

arguments.name: display
arguments.text: Open the file in a browser. The translation uses the standard-library browser instead of utils::browseURL.

arguments.name: clean
arguments.text: When true, sleep one second and delete the file. Defaults to display.

origin.details: Intended for examples. The returned path may already have been deleted when clean is true.
origin.example: page <- in_html("x", css="P {color: red}", display=FALSE) writeLines(readLines(page)) unlink(page)

translation.description: Assemble HTML and CSS into a temporary file and, by default, open it.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string or a list of HTML strings.

arguments.name: css
arguments.text: A string or list of CSS. None or an empty list omits the style element.

arguments.name: clean
arguments.text: When true, sleep one second and delete the file. Defaults to display.

translation.details: The returned path may already have been deleted when clean is true.
translation.example: import os from fansi import in_html path = in_html("x", css="P {color: red}", display=False) print(open(path, encoding="utf-8").read(), end="") os.remove(path)
